discovery_notes: Follow-up 3 to packets 239/263/287, reusing their keys; 27 search snippets. No new pins. Tiana & Prince Naveen structure hold released via a Pink a la Mode per-pin listing (new identity hold added for the undated listing). Hades & Megara Wave 1 pin gets LE 200 from a store listing. Robin Hood names, Turning Red, Wave 1 vs Enchanted Princess, NBC/Gothic/Poster, debut, Frozen 4-5, Crest 12th and Carousel remain unresolved. Retailer only; no manufacturer claims.
